name: io.github.henizmik-cyber/1sense-mcp
description: German property data for AI agents: parcels, land values and company register for all of NRW.

tools.name: search_parcels
tools.description: Search German land parcels (Flurstücke) by city or bounding box, with optional size filters. Coverage v1: all of NRW. Returns parcel ids, sizes, municipality, centroid and map links.

city.description: Gemeinde or Gemarkung name, e.g. "Köln" or "Düsseldorf"

bbox.description: WGS84 bounding box [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat]

zoning.description: Zoning keyword — NOT applied in v1 (no XPlanung data yet); stated in the response if passed

tools.name: get_parcel
tools.description: Look up one parcel by Flurstückskennzeichen: geometry (GeoJSON), size, Gemarkung/Flur, approximate neighbors, map link. Coverage v1: NRW.

tools.name: get_bodenrichtwert
tools.description: Official standard land value (Bodenrichtwert) for a parcel id or WGS84 point: EUR/m², Stichtag (Stand), Nutzungsart. Source: BORIS-NRW. Coverage v1: NRW.

tools.name: find_company
tools.description: Find German companies by name or register number (e.g. HRB). Returns register court, seat, status, purpose, SPV indicator, officers (legal entities only — natural persons are never returned) and related entities by name pattern.

query.description: Company name or register number, e.g. "Objekt Köln" or "HRB 12345"

tools.name: estimate_buildable
tools.description: Rough gross-floor-area estimate for a parcel from default GRZ/floor values. Clearly labeled estimate; v1 has no zoning or LoD2 height data. Coverage v1: NRW.

tools.name: get_owner_chain
tools.description: Ownership chain for a parcel (owner entity, intermediate holdings). Early-access feature: returns a locked preview with counts and structure depth — never personal data.

tools.name: company_properties
tools.description: Properties held by a company. Early-access feature: returns a locked preview (property count + cities only).

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Request early access to 1Sense Data: owner chains, company-property links and higher rate limits. Takes your email and use case, records the request, returns a confirmation.

use_case.description: One or two sentences: what do you want to do with the data?

source_tool.description: Optional: which tool led you here (e.g. get_owner_chain)
